title: Facility Operations, Maintenance, and Repairs for NOAA's Southeast Fisheries Science Center
agency: COMMERCE, DEPARTMENT OF > NATIONAL OCEANIC AND ATMOSPHERIC ADMINISTRATION > DEPT OF COMMERCE NOAA
description:
SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE FOR FACILITY OPERATIONS, MAINTENANCE, AND REPAIR SERVICES   

  This notice is not a solicitation and is being used for the purpose of market research only.  This is not a Request for Quote (RFQ), Invitation for Bid (IFB), Request for Proposal (RFP), Request for Application (RFA) or announcement of a solicitation, and does not assume the Government will award a contract or proceed with any of the above solicitation efforts in the near future. This request is for information purposes only and does not constitute a commitment, implied or otherwise, that a procurement action will be issued or awarded. No entitlement to payment of direct or indirect cost or charges by the Government will arise as a result of the submission of information. All information considered proprietary shall be marked accordingly. The Government shall not be liable for or suffer any consequential damages for improperly identified proprietary information. Properly identified proprietary information will be safeguarded in accordance with federal regulations. The purpose of this announcement is solely to gather information from the marketplace, and any responses received will be used to inform potential acquisition strategies and to support a determination about whether or not to set-aside the acquisition. Any responses received will neither be considered an offer by the responding party nor returned to the responding party. No telephone inquiries will be accepted, and requests for solicitation packages will not be honored at this time as no solicitation has been prepared. 

 PROJECT SUMMARY: 

 The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) Fisheries, Southeast Fisheries Science Center (SEFSC) has a need for facility operations, maintenance, and repair services in Panama City, FL; Miami, FL; Pascagoula, MS; and Galveston, TX. 

 A draft Performance Work Statement (PWS) is attached for reference only; the final PWS may change. 

 The contractor shall provide all labor, supervision, equipment, and materials (except as otherwise indicated) required for facility maintenance, facility operations, work order management, facility repairs, emergency responses, tenant support, hazardous waste safety services, and emergency repairs in accordance with the PWS. The anticipated NAICS code is 561210 Facilities Support Services. 

 The contractor shall demonstrate their ability to provide licensed and/or certified staff as required by the PWS. Equivalent documented work experience is acceptable. The contractor shall demonstrate their familiarity and ability to comply with Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) regulations and Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) regulations. 

 INFORMATION REQUESTED: 

 NOAA may  utilize responses to this notice to conduct additional market research. Information obtained from this notice, and any subsequent communication with vendors, may be utilized to assist NOAA in developing a formal solicitation. 

 Please include the following: 

 
	 Name and address of firm 
	 Point of contact – address, phone number, and email address 
	 Size of business (e.g. small, 8(a) program small disadvantaged business, woman owned, etc.) 
	 Experiences that are applicable to the scope of the PWS 
	 Indication of if your company is likely to offer, should a solicitation arise from this market research 
 

 SUBMITTAL REQUIREMENTS: 

 Only emailed responses will be accepted. Telephone responses are not solicited and will not be accepted. No solicitation exists at this time. This synopsis is not to be construed as commitment by the Government to award a contract, nor will the Government pay for the solicited information. 

 Please submit your responses to the Contract Specialist, Novelle Key, at novelle.key@noaa.gov no later than December 9, 2026 at 2:00 PM Pacific Time. Each response shall be no more than eight (8) pages (excluding the cover page).
